data.title: Jasmine Lane
data.about:
Jasmine Lane by Elie Saab is a residential masterpiece that can be seen in Dubai’s exclusive Jumeirah Golf Estates. This exclusive community features an assortment of luxurious mansions that were carefully crafted by Durar Group, a company known for their persistent commitment to high standards of craftsmanship and extravagance.

Take refuge in an oasis of calm, where the beautiful homes fit in with the surrounding nature and provide breathtaking views of the superb golf course. Enjoy the attraction of roomy rooms that have been thoughtfully designed to improve your quality of life and give a haven of peace. Jasmine Lane by Elie Saab is the pinnacle of luxury living, a place where artful design and stunning scenery come together to create a home unlike any other.
